descriptionMarkdown:
Specialist ammunition is normally issued or acquired by magazine, charge, belt or mission allotment. Unless a rule 
says otherwise, one specialist ammunition unit modifies one Reload cycle. A weapon can use only ammunition 
appropriate to its pattern.
Ammunition Availability Effect
Tracer / Target-Marking Controlled The first creature hit during the Reload cycle is easier to track; the next 
allied ranged attack against it before your next turn ignores Light Cover.
Manstopper Controlled Projectile weapons only. Once per turn, add +1 damage against a target 
wearing armour of AC 13 or lower before Dexterity.
Armour-Piercing Scarce Projectile or bolt weapons only. Once during the Reload cycle, one attack 
gains Armour-Breaking. Declare before the attack roll.
Incendiary Scarce
Suitable projectile, bolt or flamer weapons. Once per turn on a hit, deal 
+1d4 fire damage. The ammunition is conspicuous and rarely appropriate 
for stealth.
Hot-Shot Charge Pack Scarce Las weapons only. Once per turn, add +1d4 radiant damage, but the 
weapon gains Overheat for that Reload cycle.
Sanctified Ammunition Rare On a hit against a daemon, Warp-Born creature or explicitly corrupted 
target, add +1d4 radiant damage.
Xenos / Exotic Magazine Rare Restores one Reload cycle for a matching xenos or otherwise exotic 
weapon. It does not grant a new property by itself.
